integrity: Mathematical proof of exhaustiveness plus complete executable enumeration of all isomorphism types through order nine; two independent refinement implementations agree.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimum-order thresholds for three strict vertex-color partition splits within finite trivially perfect graphs and within their connected subclass. No claims about arbitrary graph orders, global color-refinement amenability or independent validation. Historical priority not exhaustively established.
title: Sharp first three-round refinement thresholds in trivially perfect graphs
